newsitem.title: USA: Missouri bank stocks jump after Boatmen's deal.
newsitem.headline: Missouri bank stocks jump after Boatmen's deal.

text.p: Stocks for several Missouri banking companies jumped Friday amid talk that NationsBank Corp's deal to acquire Boatmen's Bancshares could spur a flurry of mergers with other Missouri financial institutions.
"It heats up the (mergers and acquisitions) game," said James Weber, banking analyst at A.G. Edwards & Sons.

The bid of about a 40 percent premium for Boatmen's stock was taken by analysts as an indication that there were other bidders, with those losing out on Boatmen's now likely to look at Mercantile Bancorp Inc and Roosevelt Financial Group Inc in St. Louis and Commerce Bancshares in Kansas City as acquisition targets, analysts said.
Other potential targets are Magna Group Inc and Mark Twain Bancshares Inc, analysts said.
Boatmen's was up 10-13/16 at 53-3/4 Friday. Mercantile was up 1-1/2 at 48-3/4, Roosevelt up 1/4 at 17-3/8, Commerce up 1-1/8 at 36-1/2, Magna up 7/8 at 24-7/8 and Mark Twain up 3/4 at 38-3/4.
